just_in.title: Flying to India for the Holidays: Five Fare Rules That Actually Save Money
just_in.excerpt: The lowest headline fare is often a trap — baggage tiers, weekend pricing and change fees decide what a USA-India ticket really costs. Here is how to book on the right side of each rule.

steps.step: Hold the fare before you decide
steps.detail: For tickets bought 7+ days before departure, US rules require a 24-hour fare hold or a full refund on cancellation within 24 hours.

steps.step: Price the ticket with your bags included
steps.detail: Compare VALUE vs CLASSIC tiers: one free checked bag vs two can swing the real price by roughly $240 per extra bag.

steps.step: Shift to a Wednesday or Thursday departure
steps.detail: Midweek departures on USA-India routes are consistently cheaper than Friday-Sunday flights.

steps.step: Book a round trip only if dates are fixed
steps.detail: A round trip usually totals less than two one-ways and changes incur the process once; only book it if both dates are firm.
A date change adds a fee plus fare difference to whatever subclass is still open — the classic way a cheap ticket stops being cheap.

immigration.title: Arizona DACA Renewals Now Take Five to Six Months as Delays Cost Jobs and Licences
immigration.excerpt: Arizona advocates say renewal waits have stretched from about two months to five or six months under new USCIS screening and biometrics requirements. CBS News reports the national backlog of pending renewals has passed 125,000.

immigration.title: DHS Makes End of 540-Day Work Permit Extension Permanent in Final Rule
immigration.excerpt: The Department of Homeland Security's final rule, effective on Federal Register publication on October 14, means most EAD renewals filed on or after October 30, 2025 no longer extend work authorization while they are pending — a direct hit for H-4 spouses and asylum applicants.
immigration.image_caption: The US Department of Homeland Security headquarters in Washington, DC. DHS made the end of the 540-day work permit extension permanent in a final rule.
immigration.nri_angle: H-4 spouses of H-1B workers — most of them Indian women — lose the safety net that kept them employed while USCIS processed renewals; a pending renewal no longer extends the card past its printed expiry date.

immigration.title: DHS Proposes Ending Deference to Prior H-1B and L-1 Petition Approvals
immigration.excerpt: A proposed rule would remove the requirement that USCIS defer to earlier I-129 approvals, exposing H-1B and L-1 extensions and amendments to fresh adjudication, more evidence requests, and higher denial risk.
immigration.image_caption: The US Department of Homeland Security headquarters in Washington, DC. DHS has proposed ending automatic deference to prior H-1B and L-1 petition approvals.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian nationals are a large share of H-1B holders and file repeated extensions while awaiting green cards, so losing deference to prior approvals would make renewals less predictable for workers and employers.

immigration.title: Iowa City Mother of Four Deported to Sierra Leone Before a Judge Heard Her Case
